steps.description: The user's hypothesis describes a pure mathematical/ML experiment investigating "solution space rigidity" using neural networks. No physical simulation or external tool is required. I will create a Python script that implements the bootstrap rigidity test: generating abstract constraints (e.g., polynomial evaluations or geometric inequalities), training small feedforward networks of varying widths on $w$ samples, measuring the minimum width $N_c(w)$ required to achieve zero violation on held-out constraints, and plotting the trend. This aligns with the "coder" mode as we must implement the custom experimental logic from scratch to measure the specific mathematical quantity requested.
